query_mix: Patna event food and traditional products
Bihar culinary heritage with current 2026 signals
food discovery products with dish-level and social graph patterns

findings.statement: Two independent 2026 editorial guides describe Exhibition Road as a dense street-food destination and identify overlapping dish categories including samosa, kachori, chaat, jalebi and sweets.
Bihar Saras Mela at Gyan Bhawan is an active food and rural-product event through September 29, 2026; reporting on September 23 put cumulative business above Rs 68.56 lakh after three days.
findings.note: Sales are reported event figures, not independently audited financial data.

findings.statement: Eatables positions dish-level discovery around reviews from people who actually ate the dish, neighbourhood activity, personal must-try lists and non-paid ranking.
HOGR combines friend and influencer recommendations, social feeds, food video content and incentives for recommendations.
Beli combines personal restaurant history, saved lists, maps and friend recommendations.

contradictions.statement: The corridor-density claim is supported by two editorial guides but neither is a municipal or mapping authority; retain medium confidence rather than upgrading to high confidence.
Current sales figures are reported by local media and should not be treated as audited financial totals.

dedupe_actions: Did not create a second Exhibition Road locality entity.
Did not duplicate Saras Mela; appended a new time-stamped observation to the same event concept.
Kept Beli, HOGR and Eatables as product-pattern entities rather than Patna food entities.

implementation.schema_change: Add observation as a first-class temporal evidence record.
implementation.product_change: Model event, creator, place and locality metrics as dated observations so changing values do not overwrite history.
implementation.next_ui: Add evidence timeline to locality, dish and event pages.
